bundle.shortDescription: A calm desktop workbench for Codex and Claude Code.
bundle.longDescription: Bindaas is an unofficial, open-source macOS app for working with coding agents. It drives your own installed Codex CLI, Claude Code, or both: follow live activity, answer questions and approvals, review changes, and browse or edit project files. Not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
